patches.name: global-platform-pc
patches.reason: AppUtils.InitPlatformType: map the iOS/macOS runtime branch to app platform enum 3 (PC/Windows); Unity RuntimePlatform itself remains iOS.

patches.name: mobile-settings-gate-for-pc-platform
patches.reason: Experimental: AppUtils.IsMobilePlatform keeps its enum-2 branch and compares the other platform value against PC enum 3, allowing mobile-gated settings/UI paths while the app platform remains PC.

validation.keyboard_mouse: Experimental; the global app platform remains PC, while AppUtils.IsMobilePlatform also returns true for PC enum 3. Broader call sites may change.
validation.trackpad: Experimental; intended to restore mobile-gated settings/UI paths. Graphics options and backdrop are not yet confirmed.
